title: The LangChain Ecosystem: LangChain, LangGraph & LangSmith
description: You've built tool calling, RAG, agents, and memory by hand. Now learn the industry-standard framework that packages all of it, and know exactly which parts it automates versus which mental models still matter.
learningOutcomes: Compose LLM calls with LangChain's Runnable interface and LCEL instead of hand-rolled request code
Rebuild a retriever, memory, and tool-using chain with LangChain abstractions
Build the same agent loop from Module 6 as an explicit LangGraph state graph
Trace, debug, and evaluate a chain or agent in production with LangSmith

lessons.title: LangChain Fundamentals: Chains, LCEL, and Runnables
lessons.description: The Runnable interface and the pipe operator that replaces hand-written request/response glue code.
learningObjectives: Explain what a Runnable actually is under the hood
Compose a chain with the | operator instead of manual function calls
Map every LCEL primitive back to code you already wrote by hand

lessons.title: Retrievers, Memory, and Tools in LangChain
lessons.description: Rebuild your Module 5 retriever, Module 7 memory, and Module 3 tool-calling loop using LangChain's abstractions.
learningObjectives: Wrap a vector store as a LangChain retriever
Attach conversation memory to a chain correctly
Bind tools to a model call the LangChain way and compare it to raw function calling

lessons.title: LangGraph: Building Agents as Graphs
lessons.description: Model the agent loop from Module 6 explicitly as a state graph with nodes, edges, and conditional routing.
learningObjectives: Explain why an explicit graph beats an implicit while-loop for a non-trivial agent
Define nodes, edges, and conditional routing in LangGraph
Persist and inspect agent state between graph steps

lessons.title: LangSmith: Tracing, Evaluation, and Debugging in Production
lessons.description: See every step of a chain or agent run, and turn your Module 2 eval harness into a tracked LangSmith dataset.
learningObjectives: Read a LangSmith trace to find exactly which step in a chain failed
Turn an eval set into a LangSmith dataset with tracked runs over time
Decide when tracing infrastructure is worth adding to a project

assignment.title: Assignment: Port Your Hand-Built Agent to LangGraph + LangSmith
assignment.description: Reimplement the agent you built by hand in Module 6 as a LangGraph graph with LangSmith tracing wired in, and defend the tradeoffs in writing.
learningObjectives: Port a hand-built agent loop to an equivalent LangGraph implementation without losing behavior
Wire up LangSmith tracing and use it to debug a deliberately broken run
Write a short, specific comparison of what the framework bought you and what it cost
